1.question: How often do themed evenings take place?
1.answer: Themed evenings and gastronomic events follow a schedule—typically 2–4 times a month. We publish dates on social media and share them when you book.

2.question: What is city delivery pricing, and do you deliver outside the city?
2.answer: Delivery within Almaty starts from 1,000 ₸; above the threshold stated in the Delivery section, delivery may be complimentary. Out-of-town delivery is available by arrangement—please ask the host in advance.

3.question: Is online consultation available?
3.answer: Yes—message us on WhatsApp or Instagram. Our administrator will help with the menu, reservations, and events.

4.question: How many guests fit at one table?
4.answer: In the main dining room, two to eight guests per table is comfortable. For larger parties we can combine tables or suggest a VIP room.

5.question: What is the buyout price for the main dining room?
5.answer: Main room buyouts are quoted individually based on date, time, and menu. Call the manager—we will tailor an offer to your format.

6.question: What is the buyout price for the karaoke room?
6.answer: The karaoke room and private zones are booked as turnkey packages. We will quote after timing, guest count, and catering are confirmed.

7.question: May we bring our own alcohol?
7.answer: Our policy on outside alcohol is confirmed at booking. As a rule, AURUM offers a curated wine and bar list.

8.question: Can we extend service after closing?
8.answer: Extensions may be possible by prior agreement when no other bookings conflict. Please discuss details with the administrator in advance.

About.heroTitle: AURUM: the gold standard of taste
About.heroLead: We created a space where gastronomy meets culture. At AURUM every dish is crafted from rare ingredients, and every guest is the centre of our world. Immerse yourself in refined calm and seamless service.
About.heroCardText: AURUM is an intimate restaurant with a chef-driven menu, a wine programme, and fine-dining service.
About.sectionLead: Our kitchen is guided by seasonality, local farms, and world-class technique. We honour tradition and reinterpret classics—from starters to dessert.
About.p1: Chefs, sommeliers, and floor managers work as one so every visit feels effortless and complete. We listen and adapt—to a business dinner, a family celebration, or an intimate evening for two.
About.p2: The interior supports the mood: deep wood and brass, soft light, and private corners. This is not abstract hotel glamour—it is a real restaurant where plating temperature and the rhythm of the evening matter.

Chef.title: The AURUM kitchen
Chef.name: Executive chef, AURUM
Chef.bio: Over fifteen years in professional kitchens, leading premium dining teams in Almaty, with a constant focus on craft.
Chef.quote: “We cook for the guest at the table—not for a feed. Honest flavour, precise plating, and respect for the product. Gold in our name speaks to the value of the moment, not excess shine.”
Chef.p1: The AURUM kitchen philosophy is seasonality, trusted suppliers, and clear flavour stories without overload. The menu is composed so both festive dinners and business formats feel natural and calm.
Chef.p2: Behind the scenes are disciplined processes—from receiving ingredients to final plating. We hold a high bar for consistency so every visit feels reliably warm and assured.

AboutQuote.text: Gold is not only a gleam in the interior—it is the value of moments shared at our table.
